steps.evidence: In an argon filled glove box
The reaction mixture was stirred for 2 minutes at room temperature.
To this mixture, 2-chloro-N,N-diisopropylnicotinamide (48.1 mg, 0.2 mmol) was added.
The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC. The reaction mixture was stirred for 12 h.
THF was removed under reduced pressure
dried on oil bath at 90 oC for 30 minutes

uncertainties: The procedure calls the ligand only "L1 ligand" and does not define its structure. Its alignment to r3 is provisional: r3 is the supplied ligand-like component remaining after the explicitly named components are aligned.
The pre-stirring temperature is specified only as room temperature; no numeric temperature is given.
Reduced pressure is specified for THF removal without a numeric pressure. Whether reduced pressure was also maintained during the subsequent drying is not stated.
